name: smwgraphics-night-in-the-moonlight
title: Night in the Moonlight
description:
I think screwed up on the .mwl file on my old one. I'm pretty sure I fixed it now. Please delete the old one.

The background of the level seen in this YouTube video. People wanted me to submit it, so here it is.

The palette takes up the left side of palette 0 only, and leaves the status bar palettes alone. As for Map16, it takes up around a third of a page.

In order for this to show up right in game, you must set the horizontal layer 2 background scroll to "none".

Please give credit as it is hand-drawn, and enjoy.
